newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Anhui Expressway highway in operation.
newsitem.headline: Anhui Expressway highway in operation.

text.p: Anhui Expressway Co Ltd's newly-purchased National Highway 205 has started up and traffic is expected to grow, chairman Wang Shui said on Thursday.
"We have completed the purchase of the Tianchang section of National Highway 205 and revenues have started to come in since January," he told reporters.
"Traffic will continue to grow," Wang said.

The 30-km, two-lane highway collected an average of 100,000 yuan in toll fees per day in January and 140,000 yuan a day in March. Revenue in February eased to 90,000 yuan a day but Wang attributed the fall in usage to Lunar New Year holidays.
Building of ancillary facilities along the highway is expected to be completed in July, he said.
Anhui Expressway earlier signed two letters of intent to invest in Gaohe-Jiezidun Expressway and Jiefubeng Expressway in Anhui province.
Wang said the company wanted to participate in toll road and bridge projects in Anhui but it would consider risks and rates of return before committing.
"We will not consider projects with a rate of return of below 15 percent," he said, adding that risks were low in the Gaohe-Jiezidun Expressway project.
Construction in the first phase of the 206-km long Jiefubeng Expressway was expected to start in the second half of 1997.
Investment for the entire project stands at 3.0 billion with about 1.8 billion to be used in the first phase.
Wang said the company was considering taking up about 30 percent of the first phase but there was no final decision yet.
